from datetime import datetime, timedelta

import pytest
from isoduration import add_duration


class TestSyntaxValidation:
    """Tests for ISO 8601 duration string syntax validation."""

    def test_valid_simple_durations(self):
        """Valid simple duration strings should parse without error."""
        base = datetime(2025, 1, 1)
        # These should not raise
        add_duration(base, "P1D")
        add_duration(base, "PT1H")
        add_duration(base, "P1Y")
        add_duration(base, "P1M")
        add_duration(base, "P1W")

    def test_missing_p_designator(self):
        """P designator is required."""
        base = datetime(2025, 1, 1)
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(base, "1D")

    def test_missing_duration_component(self):
        """P without any component is invalid."""
        base = datetime(2025, 1, 1)
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(base, "P")

    def test_t_without_time_component(self):
        """T must be followed by at least one time component."""
        base = datetime(2025, 1, 1)
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(base, "PT")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(base, "P1DT")

    def test_week_cannot_combine_with_other_components(self):
        """Weeks cannot be combined with other components."""
        base = datetime(2025, 1, 1)
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(base, "P2W3D")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(base, "P1W2M")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(base, "P1YT1H")

    def test_component_order_must_be_preserved(self):
        """Components must appear in order: Y, M, W, D, T, H, M, S."""
        base = datetime(2025, 1, 1)
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(base, "P1D1M")  # D before M
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(base, "P1M1Y")  # M before Y
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(base, "PT1M1H")  # M (minutes) before H

    def test_duplicate_components_not_allowed(self):
        """Each component can appear at most once."""
        base = datetime(2025, 1, 1)
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(base, "P1D2D")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(base, "P1M2M")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(base, "PT1H2H")

    def test_sign_prefix_only(self):
        """Sign must be at the beginning, not on components."""
        base = datetime(2025, 1, 1)
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(base, "P-1D")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(base, "P1D-T1H")

    def test_whitespace_not_allowed(self):
        """No whitespace allowed anywhere."""
        base = datetime(2025, 1, 1)
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(base, "P 1D")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(base, " P1D")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(base, "P1D ")

    def test_lowercase_designators_invalid(self):
        """Designators must be uppercase."""
        base = datetime(2025, 1, 1)
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(base, "p1d")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(base, "P1d")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(base, "Pt1h")

    def test_fraction_only_on_last_component(self):
        """Only the last component may have a fractional part."""
        base = datetime(2025, 1, 1)
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(base, "P1.5D1H")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(base, "P1.5Y")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(base, "P1.5M")

    def test_fraction_requires_digits_on_both_sides(self):
        """Fractions must have at least one digit on each side of separator."""
        base = datetime(2025, 1, 1)
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(base, "PT.5H")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(base, "PT1.H")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(base, "PT,5H")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(base, "PT1,H")

    def test_valid_signs(self):
        """Plus sign is allowed; minus makes duration negative."""
        base = datetime(2025, 1, 15)
        # Plus should be accepted
        result_plus = add_duration(base, "+P1D")
        assert result_plus == datetime(2025, 1, 16)
        # Minus should negate
        result_minus = add_duration(base, "-P1D")
        assert result_minus == datetime(2025, 1, 14)

    def test_decimal_separator_dot_or_comma(self):
        """Both . and , are valid decimal separators."""
        base = datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0)
        result_dot = add_duration(base, "PT1.5H")
        result_comma = add_duration(base, "PT1,5H")
        expected = datetime(2025, 1, 1, 1, 30, 0)
        assert result_dot == expected
        assert result_comma == expected


class TestYearsAndMonths:
    """Tests for year and month components."""

    def test_add_single_year(self):
        """Adding years moves to the same date next year."""
        base = datetime(2025, 3, 15, 10, 30)
        result = add_duration(base, "P1Y")
        assert result == datetime(2026, 3, 15, 10, 30)

    def test_add_multiple_years(self):
        """Adding multiple years."""
        base = datetime(2025, 1, 1)
        result = add_duration(base, "P5Y")
        assert result == datetime(2030, 1, 1)

    def test_add_single_month(self):
        """Adding months moves to the same day next month."""
        base = datetime(2025, 1, 15)
        result = add_duration(base, "P1M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 2, 15)

    def test_add_multiple_months(self):
        """Adding multiple months."""
        base = datetime(2025, 1, 15)
        result = add_duration(base, "P3M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 4, 15)

    def test_month_wraps_year(self):
        """Adding months can wrap into the next year."""
        base = datetime(2025, 11, 15)
        result = add_duration(base, "P3M")
        assert result == datetime(2026, 2, 15)

    def test_year_and_month_together(self):
        """Year and month are applied in one step."""
        base = datetime(2024, 1, 31)
        # 1 year + 1 month = 13 months total
        result = add_duration(base, "P1Y1M")
        # From Jan 31: 13 months forward should land at Feb 29 (Feb has only 28/29 days)
        assert result == datetime(2025, 2, 28)

    def test_day_clamping_february_leap_year(self):
        """Day clamping for Feb in leap year."""
        base = datetime(2024, 1, 31)
        result = add_duration(base, "P1M")
        # Jan 31 + 1 month = Feb 29 (leap year)
        assert result == datetime(2024, 2, 29)

    def test_day_clamping_february_non_leap_year(self):
        """Day clamping for Feb in non-leap year."""
        base = datetime(2025, 1, 31)
        result = add_duration(base, "P1M")
        # Jan 31 + 1 month = Feb 28 (non-leap year)
        assert result == datetime(2025, 2, 28)

    def test_day_clamping_april(self):
        """Day clamping for month with 30 days."""
        base = datetime(2025, 5, 31)
        result = add_duration(base, "P1M")
        # May 31 + 1 month = Jun 30 (June has 30 days)
        assert result == datetime(2025, 6, 30)

    def test_no_day_clamping_when_not_needed(self):
        """Normal months don't require clamping."""
        base = datetime(2025, 1, 15)
        result = add_duration(base, "P1M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 2, 15)

    def test_hour_minute_second_preserved_through_month_addition(self):
        """Time components are preserved when adding months."""
        base = datetime(2025, 1, 31, 15, 45, 30, 123456)
        result = add_duration(base, "P1M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 2, 28, 15, 45, 30, 123456)

    def test_subtract_single_month(self):
        """Subtracting months."""
        base = datetime(2025, 3, 15)
        result = add_duration(base, "-P1M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 2, 15)

    def test_subtract_month_wraps_year(self):
        """Subtracting months can wrap into the previous year."""
        base = datetime(2025, 2, 15)
        result = add_duration(base, "-P3M")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 11, 15)

    def test_subtract_year_and_month(self):
        """Subtracting year and month together."""
        base = datetime(2024, 3, 31)
        result = add_duration(base, "-P1Y1M")
        # 13 months back from Mar 31 should land at Feb 29 (2023 is not a leap year, so Feb 28)
        assert result == datetime(2023, 2, 28)


class TestWeeks:
    """Tests for week components."""

    def test_add_single_week(self):
        """Adding a week is 7 days."""
        base = datetime(2025, 1, 1)
        result = add_duration(base, "P1W")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 8)

    def test_add_multiple_weeks(self):
        """Adding multiple weeks."""
        base = datetime(2025, 1, 1)
        result = add_duration(base, "P10W")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 12)

    def test_subtract_weeks(self):
        """Subtracting weeks."""
        base = datetime(2025, 3, 12)
        result = add_duration(base, "-P10W")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1)

    def test_weeks_alone_valid(self):
        """Weeks can be used alone."""
        base = datetime(2025, 1, 1)
        result = add_duration(base, "P5W")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 2, 5)

    def test_weeks_cannot_combine_with_days(self):
        """Weeks cannot be combined with days."""
        base = datetime(2025, 1, 1)
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(base, "P1W1D")

    def test_weeks_cannot_combine_with_time(self):
        """Weeks cannot be combined with time components."""
        base = datetime(2025, 1, 1)
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(base, "P1WT1H")


class TestDays:
    """Tests for day components."""

    def test_add_single_day(self):
        """Adding a single day."""
        base = datetime(2025, 1, 1)
        result = add_duration(base, "P1D")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 2)

    def test_add_multiple_days(self):
        """Adding multiple days."""
        base = datetime(2025, 1, 1)
        result = add_duration(base, "P10D")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 11)

    def test_days_cross_month_boundary(self):
        """Days can cross month boundaries."""
        base = datetime(2025, 1, 25)
        result = add_duration(base, "P10D")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 2, 4)

    def test_days_cross_year_boundary(self):
        """Days can cross year boundaries."""
        base = datetime(2025, 12, 25)
        result = add_duration(base, "P10D")
        assert result == datetime(2026, 1, 4)

    def test_subtract_days(self):
        """Subtracting days."""
        base = datetime(2025, 1, 15)
        result = add_duration(base, "-P5D")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 10)

    def test_subtract_days_cross_month_boundary(self):
        """Subtracting days can cross month boundaries backward."""
        base = datetime(2025, 2, 5)
        result = add_duration(base, "-P10D")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 26)


class TestTime:
    """Tests for hour, minute, and second components."""

    def test_add_single_hour(self):
        """Adding a single hour."""
        base = datetime(2025, 1, 1, 10, 0, 0)
        result = add_duration(base, "PT1H")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 11, 0, 0)

    def test_add_hours_cross_day(self):
        """Adding hours can cross day boundary."""
        base = datetime(2025, 1, 1, 22, 0, 0)
        result = add_duration(base, "PT3H")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 2, 1, 0, 0)

    def test_add_single_minute(self):
        """Adding a single minute."""
        base = datetime(2025, 1, 1, 10, 0, 0)
        result = add_duration(base, "PT1M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 10, 1, 0)

    def test_add_minutes_cross_hour(self):
        """Adding minutes can cross hour boundary."""
        base = datetime(2025, 1, 1, 10, 55, 0)
        result = add_duration(base, "PT10M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 11, 5, 0)

    def test_add_single_second(self):
        """Adding a single second."""
        base = datetime(2025, 1, 1, 10, 0, 0)
        result = add_duration(base, "PT1S")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 10, 0, 1)

    def test_add_seconds_cross_minute(self):
        """Adding seconds can cross minute boundary."""
        base = datetime(2025, 1, 1, 10, 0, 55)
        result = add_duration(base, "PT10S")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 10, 1, 5)

    def test_add_combined_time(self):
        """Adding hours, minutes, and seconds together."""
        base = datetime(2025, 1, 1, 10, 0, 0)
        result = add_duration(base, "PT2H30M45S")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 12, 30, 45)

    def test_subtract_time(self):
        """Subtracting time."""
        base = datetime(2025, 1, 1, 15, 30, 45)
        result = add_duration(base, "-PT2H15M20S")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 13, 15, 25)

    def test_subtract_time_cross_day_boundary(self):
        """Subtracting time can cross day boundary backward."""
        base = datetime(2025, 1, 2, 2, 0, 0)
        result = add_duration(base, "-PT3H")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 23, 0, 0)

    def test_m_before_t_is_months(self):
        """M before T is months, not minutes."""
        base = datetime(2025, 1, 15)
        result = add_duration(base, "P2M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 15)

    def test_m_after_t_is_minutes(self):
        """M after T is minutes."""
        base = datetime(2025, 1, 1, 10, 0, 0)
        result = add_duration(base, "PT30M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 10, 30, 0)


class TestFractionalComponents:
    """Tests for fractional duration components."""

    def test_fractional_day_half(self):
        """Half a day is 12 hours."""
        base = datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0)
        result = add_duration(base, "P0.5D")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0)

    def test_fractional_day_quarter(self):
        """Quarter day is 6 hours."""
        base = datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0)
        result = add_duration(base, "P0.25D")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 6, 0, 0)

    def test_fractional_hour_half(self):
        """Half an hour is 30 minutes."""
        base = datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0)
        result = add_duration(base, "PT0.5H")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 30, 0)

    def test_fractional_minute_half(self):
        """Half a minute is 30 seconds."""
        base = datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0)
        result = add_duration(base, "PT0.5M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 30)

    def test_fractional_second(self):
        """Fractional seconds are preserved as microseconds."""
        base = datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0)
        result = add_duration(base, "PT0.5S")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 500000)

    def test_fractional_second_full_precision(self):
        """Fractional seconds with full microsecond precision."""
        base = datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0)
        result = add_duration(base, "PT0.123456S")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 123456)

    def test_fractional_week_half(self):
        """Half a week is 3.5 days."""
        base = datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0)
        result = add_duration(base, "P0.5W")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 4, 12, 0, 0)

    def test_fractional_with_comma_separator(self):
        """Comma separator also works for fractions."""
        base = datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0)
        result = add_duration(base, "PT0,5H")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 30, 0)

    def test_fractional_larger_number(self):
        """Fractional component with larger integer part."""
        base = datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0)
        result = add_duration(base, "PT1.5H")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 1, 30, 0)

    def test_fractional_day_with_months(self):
        """Fractional day combined with months."""
        base = datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0)
        result = add_duration(base, "P1M0.5D")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 2, 1, 12, 0, 0)

    def test_negative_fractional(self):
        """Negative fractional durations."""
        base = datetime(2025, 1, 2, 0, 0, 0)
        result = add_duration(base, "-P0.5D")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0)


class TestApplicationOrder:
    """Tests for the order of applying duration components."""

    def test_months_then_weeks_then_time(self):
        """Components are applied in order: months, weeks/days, time."""
        base = datetime(2024, 1, 31, 0, 0, 0)
        # Apply 1 month (clamps to Feb 29) then 1 day then 1 hour
        result = add_duration(base, "P1M1DT1H")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 3, 1, 1, 0, 0)

    def test_months_before_day_overflow_handling(self):
        """Month application affects day clamping before days are added."""
        base = datetime(2024, 1, 31)
        # 1 month brings us to Feb 29, then add 1 day
        result = add_duration(base, "P1M1D")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 3, 1)

    def test_negative_month_then_negative_day(self):
        """Negative components apply in order: months first, then days."""
        base = datetime(2024, 3, 31)
        # Back 1 month to Feb 29, then back 1 day
        result = add_duration(base, "-P1M1D")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 2, 28)

    def test_all_components_together(self):
        """All component types together."""
        base = datetime(2025, 1, 15, 10, 30, 0)
        result = add_duration(base, "P1Y2M3DT4H5M6S")
        assert result == datetime(2026, 3, 18, 14, 35, 6)


class TestNegativeDurations:
    """Tests for negative (subtraction) durations."""

    def test_negative_prefix_negates_all_parts(self):
        """Negative sign at the start negates the entire duration."""
        base = datetime(2025, 6, 15, 12, 30, 0)
        result = add_duration(base, "-P1M2DT3H")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 5, 13, 9, 30, 0)

    def test_plus_prefix_no_effect(self):
        """Plus sign at start has no effect."""
        base = datetime(2025, 1, 15)
        result_plus = add_duration(base, "+P1D")
        result_no_sign = add_duration(base, "P1D")
        assert result_plus == result_no_sign

    def test_negative_crossing_boundaries(self):
        """Negative durations correctly cross boundaries."""
        base = datetime(2025, 1, 5)
        result = add_duration(base, "-P10D")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 12, 26)

    def test_negative_fractional(self):
        """Negative fractional durations."""
        base = datetime(2025, 1, 2, 12, 0, 0)
        result = add_duration(base, "-P0.5D")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 2, 0, 0, 0)


class TestMicrosecondPrecision:
    """Tests for microsecond precision and rounding."""

    def test_fractional_second_rounding(self):
        """Fractional seconds round to nearest microsecond."""
        base = datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0)
        # 0.0000001 seconds = 0.1 microseconds, rounds to 0
        result = add_duration(base, "PT0.0000001S")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0)

    def test_microsecond_precision_preserved(self):
        """Microseconds in fractional seconds are preserved."""
        base = datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0)
        result = add_duration(base, "PT0.000001S")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 1)

    def test_time_combination_precision(self):
        """Combined time components maintain microsecond precision."""
        base = datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0)
        result = add_duration(base, "PT1H30M45.5S")
        expected = datetime(2025, 1, 1, 1, 30, 45, 500000)
        assert result == expected


class TestEdgeCases:
    """Tests for edge cases and boundary conditions."""

    def test_leap_year_february(self):
        """Leap year February has 29 days."""
        base = datetime(2024, 2, 29)
        result = add_duration(base, "P1D")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 3, 1)

    def test_leap_year_month_arithmetic(self):
        """Month arithmetic respects leap years."""
        base = datetime(2024, 1, 31)
        result = add_duration(base, "P1M")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 2, 29)

    def test_non_leap_year_february(self):
        """Non-leap year February has 28 days."""
        base = datetime(2025, 1, 31)
        result = add_duration(base, "P1M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 2, 28)

    def test_december_31_plus_one_day(self):
        """Adding day from Dec 31 crosses year boundary."""
        base = datetime(2025, 12, 31, 23, 59, 59)
        result = add_duration(base, "PT1S")
        assert result == datetime(2026, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0)

    def test_january_1_minus_one_day(self):
        """Subtracting day from Jan 1 crosses year boundary backward."""
        base = datetime(2026, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0)
        result = add_duration(base, "-P1D")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 12, 31)

    def test_max_datetime_overflow_raises(self):
        """Adding duration beyond max datetime raises ValueError."""
        base = datetime(9999, 12, 31)
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(base, "P1D")

    def test_min_datetime_underflow_raises(self):
        """Subtracting duration below min datetime raises ValueError."""
        base = datetime(1, 1, 1)
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(base, "-P1D")

    def test_zero_values_allowed(self):
        """Zero values in components are allowed."""
        base = datetime(2025, 1, 15, 10, 30, 0)
        result = add_duration(base, "P0Y0M0DT0H0M0S")
        assert result == base

    def test_leading_zeros(self):
        """Leading zeros in components are allowed."""
        base = datetime(2025, 1, 1)
        result = add_duration(base, "P01D")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 2)

    def test_multiple_leading_zeros(self):
        """Multiple leading zeros."""
        base = datetime(2025, 1, 1, 10, 0, 0)
        result = add_duration(base, "PT00005H")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 1, 15, 0, 0)

    def test_datetime_with_microseconds_preserved(self):
        """Microseconds in input datetime are preserved."""
        base = datetime(2025, 1, 1, 10, 30, 45, 123456)
        result = add_duration(base, "P1D")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 2, 10, 30, 45, 123456)

    def test_multiple_months_february_clamping(self):
        """Multiple months with February clamping."""
        base = datetime(2024, 1, 31)
        result = add_duration(base, "P13M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 2, 28)

    def test_many_years(self):
        """Large year values."""
        base = datetime(2025, 6, 15)
        result = add_duration(base, "P100Y")
        assert result == datetime(2125, 6, 15)

    def test_very_large_day_value(self):
        """Large day values."""
        base = datetime(2025, 1, 1)
        result = add_duration(base, "P365D")
        assert result == datetime(2026, 1, 1)

    def test_very_large_second_value(self):
        """Large second values."""
        base = datetime(2025, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0)
        result = add_duration(base, "PT86400S")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 1, 2, 0, 0, 0)

from datetime import datetime

import pytest
from isoduration import add_duration


class TestSyntaxValidation:
    """Tests for ISO 8601 duration syntax validation."""

    def test_missing_p_designator(self):
        """P designator is required."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "1Y")

    def test_empty_duration(self):
        """Empty duration string is invalid."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "")

    def test_p_alone_no_components(self):
        """P alone with no components is invalid."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "P")

    def test_pt_alone_no_time_components(self):
        """PT alone with no time components is invalid."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "PT")

    def test_p_with_no_duration_component_before_t(self):
        """P1DT with no time components after T is invalid."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "P1DT")

    def test_whitespace_not_allowed(self):
        """Whitespace is not allowed anywhere in duration."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "P 1D")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), " P1D")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "P1D ")

    def test_sign_on_component_not_allowed(self):
        """Sign on components (not at start) is invalid."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "P-1D")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "P+1D")

    def test_lowercase_designators_not_allowed(self):
        """Designators must be uppercase."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "p1d")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "P1d")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "P1y")

    def test_component_order_violation(self):
        """Components must appear in order: Y, M, W, D, T, H, M, S."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "P1D1Y")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "P1M1D1Y")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "P1DT1H1D")

    def test_duplicate_components(self):
        """Each component can appear at most once."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "P1Y2Y")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "P1M2M")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "P1D2D")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "PT1H2H")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "PT1M2M")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "PT1S2S")

    def test_weeks_incompatible_with_other_components(self):
        """Weeks cannot be combined with any other component."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "P2W3D")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "P1Y2W")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "P1M2W")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "P2WT1H")

    def test_weeks_alone_is_valid(self):
        """P followed by weeks and nothing else is valid."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "P2W")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 24)

    def test_m_before_t_is_months(self):

        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 15), "P1M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 2, 15)

    def test_m_after_t_is_minutes(self):
        """M after T is interpreted as minutes, not months."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10, 10, 0), "PT1M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 10, 10, 1)

    def test_missing_number_before_designator(self):

        with pytest.raises(ValueError):

        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "PT H")

    def test_no_designator_after_number(self):
        """A number must have a designator after it."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "P1")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "PT1")

    def test_invalid_characters(self):

        with pytest.raises(ValueError):

        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "PT1Z")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "P@1D")

    def test_fraction_on_years_not_allowed(self):
        """Fractions are not allowed on years."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):

    def test_fraction_on_months_not_allowed(self):
        """Fractions are not allowed on months."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "P1.5M")

    def test_fraction_on_non_last_component(self):
        """Fractions are only allowed on the last component."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "P1.5DT1H")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "PT1.5H2M")

    def test_fraction_with_missing_digits(self):

        with pytest.raises(ValueError):

        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "PT1.S")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "PT1.0.5S")

    def test_multiple_decimal_separators(self):
        """Only one decimal separator is allowed."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10), "PT1.2.3S")

    def test_valid_fraction_with_dot(self):
        """Fraction with dot separator is valid."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10, 0, 0, 0), "PT1.5S")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 10, 0, 0, 1, 500000)

    def test_valid_fraction_with_comma(self):
        """Fraction with comma separator is valid."""

class TestMonthCalculations:
    """Tests for month addition and calendar month handling."""

    def test_month_overflow_february_leap_year(self):
        """Adding month to Jan 31 in leap year goes to Feb 29, not Feb 31."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 31), "P1M")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 2, 29)

    def test_month_overflow_february_non_leap_year(self):
        """Adding month to Jan 31 in non-leap year goes to Feb 28."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 1, 31), "P1M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 2, 28)

    def test_month_overflow_april(self):
        """Adding month to May 31 goes to June 30."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 5, 31), "P1M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 6, 30)

    def test_multiple_months_crossing_year(self):
        """Adding months crosses year boundary."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 11, 15), "P3M")
        assert result == datetime(2026, 2, 15)

    def test_negative_month_overflow(self):
        """Subtracting month handles day-of-month correctly."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 3, 31), "-P1M")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 2, 29)

    def test_months_and_years_combined_in_one_step(self):
        """Years and months are added in one step, not separately."""
        # 2024-02-29 + 1Y1M should be 2025-03-29, not 2025-02-29 (then to 2025-03-29)
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 2, 29), "P1Y1M")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 29)

    def test_leap_year_february_29(self):
        """Feb 29 in leap year is handled correctly."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 2, 29), "P1Y")
        # 2024 is leap year, 2025 is not, so Feb 29 becomes Feb 28
        assert result == datetime(2025, 2, 28)

    def test_leap_year_february_29_add_to_leap_year(self):
        """Feb 29 in leap year stays on Feb 29 when adding to another leap year."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 2, 29), "P4Y")
        # 2024 is leap year, 2028 is leap year
        assert result == datetime(2028, 2, 29)

class TestApplicationOrder:
    """Tests for the order of applying duration components."""

    def test_years_months_before_days(self):
        """Years and months are applied before days."""
        # Jan 31 + 1 month + 1 day should be Feb 29 + 1 day = Mar 1 (leap year)
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 31), "P1M1D")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 3, 1)

    def test_days_before_time(self):
        """Days are applied before time."""
        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10, 10, 0, 0), "P1DT1H")
        assert result == datetime(2025, 3, 11, 11, 0, 0)

    def test_intermediate_dates_valid(self):
        """Intermediate steps should also be valid dates."""
        # This test ensures that the algorithm doesn't overflow days incorrectly
        result = add_duration(datetime(2024, 1, 31), "P1M")
        assert result == datetime(2024, 2, 29)
        # Now add another month to ensure Feb 29 is correctly handled
        result2 = add_duration(result, "P1M")
        assert result2 == datetime(2024, 3, 29)


class TestNegativeDurationOrder:

        with pytest.raises(ValueError):

        result = add_duration(datetime(2025, 3, 10, 0, 0, 0), "PT0.0000005S")
        # Check that it rounds to the nearest microsecond
